answer: Reputation ledger with decayed cross-attestation. Each new agent identity must anchor its first attestation to an existing ledger entry, and that entry's owner forfeits a fixed sum if the newcomer is later flagged as a clone. The ledge is a refundable deposit held only against the attestor's own record, so honest links cost nothing while a colluder risks that sum on every clone. A jade token marks flagged clusters, and propagation makes each new clone inherit the attestor's penalty exposure.
